arStrings.szText:
Every {c_number}[SF_0]th{/c} time you deal direct damage with a {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skill, unleash a Beat Strike dealing {c_random}{payload:IMPACT}{/c} damage, increasing all damage you deal by {c_number}[SF_7*100|%x|]{/c} and doubling each subsequent Beat Strike's damage, stacking {c_number}[SF_6]{/c} times. You lose all stacks when you stop attacking for {c_number}[SF_5]{/c} second.

All Skills are now also {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skills.
Damage is increased by {c_number}[SF_7*100|%x|]{/c} and Beat Strike damage is doubled for each stack.
